# Churn prediction model v2 (Example Widgets Inc., synthetic)
The model predicts which subscription customers will cancel in the next 60 days. On last quarter's held-out data it caught 71% of churners (recall) and 64% of customers it flagged did churn (precision).
Top signals: support tickets in the last 30 days, a drop in weekly logins, and a failed payment.
The retention team will call the top 500 flagged customers each month. A pilot in March saved an estimated 38 subscriptions.
